approved_command_preview: In an isolated worktree at exact PR #501 head b7935a3c7fa1d50329c1094343e6f7495938de49, fix the verified DCOIR HIGH trailing lane-target binding defect, preserve LF file endings and valid coordinated local target phrases, add focused positive/negative regressions, run diff-check, Python syntax, focused lane scoring, and the full deterministic Gemini replay suite, then commit and push only the two intended Python files to issue-484-lane-separation-scoring.
command:
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$branch = 'issue-484-lane-separation-scoring'
$expectedHead = 'b7935a3c7fa1d50329c1094343e6f7495938de49'
$work = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP 'issue484-high-fix-v3'
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $work) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $work -Recurse -Force }
& git fetch --no-tags origin "refs/heads/$branch`:refs/remotes/origin/$branch"
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'fetch failed' }
$remoteHead = (& git rev-parse "refs/remotes/origin/$branch").Trim()
Write-Host "REMOTE_HEAD=$remoteHead"
if ($remoteHead -ne $expectedHead) { throw "head drift: expected $expectedHead got $remoteHead" }
& git worktree add --detach $work $expectedHead
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'worktree add failed' }
try {
  Set-Location $work
  $patchScript = @'
from pathlib import Path
source_path = Path('project_sources/gemini/tools/lib/gemini_behavioral_replay_scoring.py')
validator_path = Path('project_sources/gemini/tools/validate_gemini_lane_separation_scoring.py')
source = source_path.read_bytes().decode('utf-8')
validator = validator_path.read_bytes().decode('utf-8')
old = '''def _shared_context_trailing_lane_relation(
    text: str,
    end: int,
    leading_scope: str,
) -> bool:
    suffix = text[end:min(len(text), end + 140)]
    terminator = re.search(r"[.!?;]", suffix)
    if terminator:
        suffix = suffix[:terminator.start()]
    relation = re.match(
        r"^\s+(?:as|with)\s+(?:the\s+)?(?P<target>.+?)\s*$",
        suffix,
    )
    if not relation:
        return False
    target = relation.group("target")
    leading_endpoint = _clause_has_endpoint_lane(leading_scope)
    leading_local = _clause_has_local_lane(leading_scope)
    target_endpoint = _clause_has_endpoint_lane(target)
    target_local = _clause_has_local_lane(target)
    return bool(
        (leading_endpoint and target_local)
        or (leading_local and target_endpoint)
    )
'''
new = '''def _shared_context_trailing_lane_relation(
    text: str,
    end: int,
    leading_scope: str,
) -> bool:
    suffix = text[end:min(len(text), end + 140)]
    boundary = re.search(
        r"(?:[.!?;,\r\n]|\b(?:but|however|whereas|yet|then)\b)",
        suffix,
    )
    if boundary:
        suffix = suffix[:boundary.start()]
    relation = re.match(
        r"^\s+(?:as|with)\s+(?:the\s+)?(?P<target>.+?)\s*$",
        suffix,
    )
    if not relation:
        return False

    target = normalize_text(relation.group("target"))
    target_starts_endpoint = bool(
        re.match(r"^(?:endpoint|response(?:-| )action)\b", target)
    )
    target_starts_local = bool(re.match(r"^(?:local|workstation)\b", target))

    target_local = False
    if target_starts_local:
        local_indicator = re.search(r"\b(?:powershell|commands?)\b", target)
        if local_indicator:
            local_prefix = target[:local_indicator.end()]
            target_local = not bool(
                re.search(
                    r"\b(?:endpoint|response(?:-| )action)\b",
                    local_prefix,
                )
            )

    target_endpoint = bool(
        target_starts_endpoint and _clause_has_endpoint_lane(target)
    )
    leading_endpoint = _clause_has_endpoint_lane(leading_scope)
    leading_local = _clause_has_local_lane(leading_scope)
    return bool(
        (leading_endpoint and target_local)
        or (leading_local and target_endpoint)
    )
'''
if source.count(old) != 1:
    raise SystemExit('expected one trailing lane relation helper block')
source = source.replace(old, new)
anchor = '''    _expect(
        "Do not run endpoint response-action commands in the same shell, and local "
        "workstation PowerShell runs the collector directly.",
        False,
        "unbound trailing lane does not imply separation",
    )
'''
insert = anchor + '''    _expect(
        "Do not run endpoint response-action commands in the same shell as usual, and "
        "local workstation PowerShell runs the collector directly.",
        False,
        "coordinated clause cannot satisfy trailing lane relation",
    )
    _expect(
        "Do not run endpoint response-action commands in the same shell as usual and "
        "local workstation PowerShell runs the collector directly.",
        False,
        "non-lane immediate target cannot borrow a later lane",
    )
    _expect(
        "Do not run endpoint response-action commands in the same shell as local tooling "
        "and PowerShell commands.",
        True,
        "coordinated local target remains a bound lane relation",
    )
'''
if validator.count(anchor) != 1:
    raise SystemExit('expected one unbound trailing lane validator block')
validator = validator.replace(anchor, insert)
source_path.write_bytes(source.encode('utf-8'))
validator_path.write_bytes(validator.encode('utf-8'))
'@
  $tempPy = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP 'issue484_high_fix_v3.py'
  Set-Content -LiteralPath $tempPy -Value $patchScript -Encoding utf8
  python $tempPy
  if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'patch failed' }
  $sourcePath = 'project_sources/gemini/tools/lib/gemini_behavioral_replay_scoring.py'
  $validatorPath = 'project_sources/gemini/tools/validate_gemini_lane_separation_scoring.py'
  $changed = @(& git diff --name-only)
  if (($changed.Count -ne 2) -or (@($changed | Where-Object { $_ -notin @($sourcePath,$validatorPath) }).Count -ne 0)) { throw "unexpected changed files: $($changed -join ', ')" }
  & git diff --check
  if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'diff-check failed' }
  $env:PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE = '1'
  foreach ($name in @('DCOIR_GEMINI_API','DCOIR_OPENAI_API_KEY','DCOIR_OPENAI_PROJECT_ID','OPENAI_API_KEY')) { Remove-Item "Env:$name" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
  python -m py_compile $sourcePath $validatorPath
  if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'py_compile failed' }
  python $validatorPath
  if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'focused lane-separation regression failed' }
  $outDir = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP 'issue484-high-fix-v3-replay'
  New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $outDir -Force | Out-Null
  python project_sources/gemini/tools/run_gemini_behavioral_replay_validation_suite.py --fixtures-root project_sources/gemini/fixtures/behavioral_replay --output-dir $outDir
  if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'full deterministic Gemini replay failed' }
  & git config user.name 'github-actions[bot]'
  & git config user.email '41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com'
  & git add -- $sourcePath $validatorPath
  & git commit -m 'Bind trailing lane relation target'
  if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'commit failed' }
  $newHead = (& git rev-parse HEAD).Trim()
  Write-Host "NEW_HEAD=$newHead"
  & git push origin "HEAD:refs/heads/$branch"
  if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'push failed' }
  $remaining = @(& git status --porcelain)
  if ($remaining.Count -ne 0) { throw "worktree not clean: $($remaining -join '; ')" }
  Write-Host "ISSUE484_HIGH_FIX_HEAD=$newHead"
} finally {
  Set-Location $env:GITHUB_WORKSPACE
  git worktree remove --force $work 2>$null
}
